name: Sreemangal

queries.query: Sreemangal Bangladesh cadastral parcel map official land records mouza map
queries.result: First-party Bangladesh DLRS/Ministry of Land sources found. The official DLRS Integrated Online Map Purchase System describes searchable CS, SA, RS, BRS and BDS Mouza maps; the official Smart Land Map portal's indexed coverage text explicitly lists শ্রীমংগল/Sreemangal. No safe anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: শ্রীমঙ্গল বাংলাদেশ খতিয়ান মৌজা মানচিত্র সরকারি ভূমি রেকর্ড
queries.result: সরকারি ভূমি নকশা পোর্টালে শ্রীমংগল নামটি মৌজা ও প্লটভিত্তিক মানচিত্র সেবার আওতাভুক্ত তালিকায় দেখা গেছে। DLRS-এর সরকারি তথ্য মৌজা মানচিত্র/খতিয়ান সেবা ও রেকর্ড কাস্টডিয়ান ব্যাখ্যা করে; নিরাপদ বেনামী পার্সেল আইডি-সহ জ্যামিতি পাওয়া যায়নি।

discoveryMethod: First-party English and Bengali discovery plus current official viewer JavaScript/configuration inspection and bounded anonymous requests
sourceReview: Bangladesh's Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) and Ministry of Land publicly operate Mouza/plot map and land-record services. The official portal text explicitly includes Sreemangal (শ্রীমংগল) among map coverage entries. This is registry/map-service custody evidence, not proof of a qualified open parcel adapter or citywide parcel coverage.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official DLRS Integrated Online Map Purchase System loaded. It describes searchable official Mouza maps for CS, SA, RS, BRS and BDS surveys, but exposes a purchase/search UI rather than a bounded parcel feature API in the retrieved page.
Official Smart Land Map portal loaded. Retrieved page text includes শ্রীমংগল/Sreemangal in the listed Upazila coverage and describes Mouza and plot based digital land zoning.

Current viewer JavaScript inspected. It exposes anonymous POST routes /getAdminByCode and /getGeomByCode, uses EPSG:4326 for displayed coordinates and EPSG:3857 for map rendering, and identifies the configured GIS base as https://gis.land.gov.bd/geoserver/. It also references a general global_search WFS route, not a verified Sreemangal parcel response.

Anonymous administrative lookup for level=forDiv returned division codes including Sylhet (60). A follow-up level=forDist request for division 60 returned only Habiganj and Sylhet in the current response; Moulvibazar was not returned, so the Sreemangal administrative chain could not be completed. No parcel geometry was requested from an unresolved chain.

An initial anonymous POST using a token from a separate page session returned Laravel Page Expired. A fresh page session and token then succeeded for the division lookup. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA bypass, or private token was used; token values were not retained.

Configured first-party GIS WFS endpoint returned Service Unavailable (no server available). No feature schema, CRS, native identity, or geometry was obtained. HTTP was not used as a TLS workaround; both HTTPS and the source-referenced HTTP route were bounded and unavailable.
Configured wsDMMS WFS capabilities route returned Service Unavailable. No parcel request was attempted after capabilities failure.
Official LGED Sreemangal Upazila map PDF was discoverable. It is an upazila/general infrastructure map, not a cadastral parcel layer, and was not retained as parcel evidence.

Official DLRS page loaded and states that Mouza maps are held by settlement offices/district record rooms and that scanned copies can be obtained from DLRS. This corroborates custodianship and procedure, not an open parcel API.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel response. Viewer code reads returned WKT as EPSG:4326 and renders map features in EPSG:3857; this is not parcel-layer CRS verification.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Not observed; no parcel feature response was obtained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Exact WUP point [24.317484346979, 91.7320887385134] was preserved; no coordinate shift or exact-point parcel query was used.
boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No usable Sreemangal parcel feature response was exposed in the bounded inspection. The 0 geometry count means no response was obtained, not citywide absence.

uncertainty: Official national cadastral/map-service custody and Sreemangal coverage are well evidenced. Current local administrative lookup completeness, live GIS availability, parcel schema, CRS, stable native identity semantics, and citywide coverage remain unverified. Runtime/admission remains held.
